notes: v0.38.0 — agent generates plan from intent. If agent_id is set, filters capabilities to agent.skills. Steps can reference capabilities that don't exist yet (with wanted_kind + wanted_description); task.run's retry-on-missing path picks those up. execute=true hands the plan straight to agentry.agent.task. Model: groq/openai-gpt-oss-120b by default, overridable via AGENTRY_PLANNER_PROVIDER + AGENTRY_PLANNER_MODEL.
